result.title: EASformer: Environment-Action-State Alignment for Industrial Generative Ranking
result.summary: Modern industrial ranking systems increasingly adopt generative recommendation (GR) paradigms, in which user behavior sequences and non-sequential (NS) features are tokenized and jointly modeled by Transformer-style backbones. This unified formulation provides a scalable interface for modeling long histories and heterogeneous features. However, sequence and NS representations often carry asymmetric semantics: historical representations may combine environment context with observed-action semantics, whereas candidate-side NS representations contain no observed action but incorporate richer supplementary context, such as user-item interaction features and recent behavior lists. Direct interaction between such representations can make query-key dot products compare different semantic objects, limiting meaningful cross-token interaction. To fill this gap, we propose EASformer, an Environment-Action-State disentangled architecture for industrial app ranking. EASformer constructs an explicitly aligned context environment space shared by historical and non-sequence tokens, while disentangling user actions from historical token and candidate-specific context form non-sequence tokens. Based on this aligned space, EASformer enables complementary historical action retrieval and state-conditioned action prediction. Furthermore, the disentangled design supports a Cloze-style self-supervised objective by masking historical actions and reusing the candidate prediction pathway. On an offline benchmark from a real-world industrial app marketplace, EASformer achieves an AUC of 0.89411, yielding a 0.88% relative improvement over the deployed baseline. Online A/B tests further support this advantage, with relative eCPM lifts of 1.26% and 3.94% across two real-world ranking scenarios.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 EASformer，在工业 app 排序的生成式推荐中把环境上下文、用户动作与候选状态解耦表示，构建历史与非序列 token 共享的对齐环境空间，并借助遮蔽历史动作、复用候选预测通路的 Cloze 式自监督目标训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「对齐共享空间 + 动作/状态解耦 + 遮蔽式监督」可能为 LVR 中区分视觉证据、推理动作与任务状态，以及训练 latent 状态 token 提供可供核查的线索，但需确认该表示设计与多模态推理的可迁移性。
